Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
select ord.customer_id,substr(name,1,26)
 into :control_block.customer_id,:cust_name
 from customers cu,
 vserv_chapters vc,
 orders ord
 where vc.chapter_id = ord.chapter_id
 and ord.chapter_id = cu.chapter_id
 and ord.customer_id = cu.customer_id
 and ((ord.order_status = 'BO' and
 exists (select 'X'
 from order_history oh
 where oh.chapter_id = ord.chapter_id
 and oh.order_no = ord.order_no
 and oh.order_status in ('PI','PA','BO')
 group by oh.order_no
 having max(from_date) < sysdate
 - (order_min_lifetime / 24))) or
 ((sysdate - ord.insert_date)*24 >
 nvl(:s_hours_old,999999) and
 ord.order_status = 'OR'))
 and ord.chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 and ord.order_no = :control_block.order_no;
exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 show_error_dist('0306');
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CANCEL_ORDER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure cancel_order is
 temp_no number;
 min_no number;
 temp_status VARCHAR2(2);
begin
 go_block('order_items');
 first_record;
 min_no := 5;
 loop
 --exit when :order_items.order_no is null; -- Commented by Kishore on 12/08/2015. IM 158
 --
 if :order_items.order_no is not null then -- Added by Kishore on 12/08/2015. IM 158
 -- find the earliest status for this item
 select min(decode(product_status, :allocated, 1, :packed, 2,
 :shipped, 3, :delivered, 4, 5))
 into temp_no
 from pick_slip_products psp, pick_slips ps
 where psp.chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 and ps.chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 and ps.pick_slip_id = psp.pick_slip_id
 and ps.order_no = :control_block.order_no
 and psp.item_no = :order_items.item_no;
 --
 -- convert back to proper status
 select decode(temp_no, 1, :allocated, 2, :packed,
 3, :shipped, 4, :closed, :sys_can )
 into temp_status
 from dual;
 
 if :item_status not in (temp_status,:canceled) then
 :item_status := temp_status;
 :order_items.program_id := :prog_name;
 end if;
 --
 if temp_no < min_no then
 min_no := temp_no;
 end if;
 --
 end if; -- if :order_items.order_no is not null then -- Added by Kishore on 12/08/2015. IM 158
 
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE'; -- Added by Kishore on 12/08/2015. IM 158
 next_record;
 end loop;
--
 go_block('orders');
 select decode(min_no, 1, :allocated, 2, :packed,
 3, :shipped, 4, :closed, :sys_can)
 into temp_status
 from dual;
 --
 if temp_status != :order_status
 then
 :orders.program_id := :prog_name;
 :order_status := temp_status;
 end if;
 --
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit_form;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_success
 then
 show_error_dist('0000');
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_code number;
 temp_msg VARCHAR2(80);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error_dist('0213');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error_dist('0214');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error_dist('0216');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error_dist('0204');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error_dist('0217');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error_dist('0218');
 elsif error_code = 40209 -- invalid entry format
 then
 show_error_dist('0246');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error_dist('0000');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0601');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026,0)
 then
 declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(20);
 begin
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2))='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error_dist('0251',disp_format_mask);
 show_error_dist('0251',GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 end;
 elsif error_code = 50025 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0509');
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error_dist('0220');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error_dist('0331');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;
 else -- unhandled Forms errors
 message('FRMS ' || to_char(error_code) || ':' || error_text);
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;
